cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 79% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.74% · WTI -1.86% · Brent +0.16% · NatGas +2.36%. 79% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +1.52%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Nuclear & Uranium lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.52%; weakest is Nuclear & Uranium at -0.74%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SEDG is the standout at +7.03%
cards.body: Leaders: SEDG +7.03%, NXT +5.64%, BE +4.76%, ARRY +3.60%, VRT +2.77%. Laggards: NRG -1.64%, TLN -1.48%, BWXT -1.47%, LNG -1.14%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
